description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

AeroVironment (AV) is a global leader in unmanned aircraft systems and tactical missile systems. They are seeking a motivated Junior Software Engineer to design, develop, and analyze low-level software and applications across Windows and Unix environments.
Junior embedded software engineer for Windows/Unix drivers, signal processing, and CI/CD pipelines

Responsibilities:
• Develop software drivers, desktop applications, and client/server applications for Windows and Unix platforms
• Design and implement low-level embedded software using primary languages including C, C++, and Python
• Analyze operating systems, computer hardware architectures, and interfaces to perform signal processing and system evaluation
• Collaborate on DevOps processes by building and deploying infrastructure technologies
• Support CI/CD pipelines to ensure automated testing, integration, and continuous deployment of software releases

Requirements:
• Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline
• 0–4 years of experience developing applications for Windows and Unix-based systems
• Proficiency in C, C++, and Python
• Basic understanding of computer hardware architecture and low-level software interaction
• An active TS/SCI with polygraph
• U.S. Citizenship required

Preferred:
• Experience with C# or Java is a plus
• Hands-on experience or familiarity with deployment and build tools such as Artifactory, Docker, Terraform, Ansible, and Packer
• Exposure to continuous integration and deployment workflows using tools like Jenkins or Bamboo
